name: Kaminstüberl
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy **Kaminstüberl** in **Leutasch** – where the warmth of the fireplace meets the rustic charm of the **Tiroler** Alps. Savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** or savory **Gröstl**, paired with a glass of local **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Schnaps**. The perfect retreat after a day of hiking or skiing in the breathtaking **Leutasch** valley.
